about.title: I work best where architecture, implementation, and quality all matter.
about.description: I am a computer engineering graduate with hands-on work in backend services, frontend development, software architecture, and quality-driven delivery. My strongest projects come from academic environments that were executed with professional standards.
about.imageCaptionText: Clear technical reasoning, structured implementation, and the discipline to document and validate what gets built.

professionalGrowth.title: Professional growth

timeline.title: How I have taken projects from requirements to delivery.
timeline.description: These are the strongest projects in my portfolio. I use this section to show responsibilities, process, and technical decisions, not just final screens.

altertex.role: Software Architect and Full Stack Developer
altertex.summary: A large-scale academic enterprise project executed with CMMI-oriented processes and a delivery model that simulated professional software work.
altertex.bullet1: Designed the solution using Hexagonal Architecture and Clean Architecture to keep the system modular and maintainable.
altertex.bullet2: Built backend services, data models, and frontend modules for users, roles, categories, quotas, and product flows.
altertex.bullet3: Implemented permission control, validation rules, and security-focused API behavior.
altertex.bullet4: Worked with formal documentation, structured reviews, and quality checkpoints across the project.
altertex.bullet5: Took an early leadership role to support estimation adjustments and coordination with the external training partner.

wushu.company: Queretaro Wushu Kung Fu Association app
wushu.role: Full Stack Developer for iOS delivery
wushu.summary: A mobile app project centered on analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, and deployment preparation for iOS.
wushu.bullet1: Analyzed functional and non-functional requirements before moving into implementation.
wushu.bullet2: Designed the mobile architecture with MVVM to keep features scalable and responsibilities separated.
wushu.bullet3: Implemented SwiftUI views and app flows with attention to usability and performance.
wushu.bullet4: Validated the product through testing and iterative improvements under a Scrum workflow.
wushu.bullet5: Prepared the application for deployment while keeping quality and security in scope.
